outputs.with:
Subject: Shift Workers, Meet Us at 10 AM on October 6!

Dear readers,

On October 6, 2026, we're shifting our Sunday opening to 10 AM. This change is designed to accommodate shift workers by extending our hours during the week.

We invite you to drop in and experience the new schedule. Whether you're a regular or joining us for the first time, this is your chance to explore how we're adapting to the changing work landscape.

See you then!

Best regards,

[Your Name]
